stance_basis: cited as one of several population projection sources in a data table with no advocacy position
summary: Economic Consultants Organization, Inc. is cited solely as a source of population projections for the Buffalo SMSA, City of Buffalo, Amherst, and Tonawanda in Table 2-10. The organization provided 1975-based trend projections through 1995 and is listed alongside other agencies and firms without expressing any position on the transit project itself.
complaint_summary: Economic Consultants Organization, Inc. is listed in Table 2-10 as a source of population projections for the Buffalo SMSA, City of Buffalo, Amherst, and Tonawanda for the years 1975–1995, providing trend-based estimates alongside several other agencies.
